short: Alejandro's compiled file · columns by agency
label: Alejandro's compiled file (labs)
note: SEDENA and FGR lab columns, 2006 to 2024 (all zero before 2006 and in 2025, left out). The FGR column shows 101 labs in 2023 against 61 in the census.

label: INEGI federal prosecutor census (FGR labs)
note: Labs seized by the federal prosecutors, 2015 to 2024. No drug produced. The printed national totals equal the sum of states in 2017 and 2018. Data year is the edition minus one.

label: Guardia Nacional answer, folio 332259822000079, Anexo I (labs)
note: July 2019 to December 2021: 2 labs, both in Tijuana in May 2020.

label: Guardia Nacional answer, folio 332259822000079, Anexo II (labs)
note: 2020 and 2021: 6 labs, in Michoacán and Sonora. Adds to Anexo I. Drug produced written for one lab (methamphetamine).

label: INEGI federal police census, Guardia Nacional (labs)
note: Labs the Guardia Nacional seized, 2024 and 2025 only: the census asks from its 2025 edition. National only. Data year is the edition minus one.

label: Federal Police answer, folio 0413100015520 (labs)
note: Labs located and handed over, 2007 to 2018 (the request runs to January 2020; no labs after December 2018). No drug produced. Of the 338 labs in 2007 to 2009, 175 were in Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City, and 130 in the city of Puebla.

label: SEDENA answer, folio 330026423000179 (labs)
finest: One row per lab: municipality, month, drug produced
note: Every lab the army found, January 1990 to December 2022, with the drug it produced: 2,681 of 2,706 made methamphetamine, 23 heroin, 2 cocaine, none fentanyl. Obtained by MUCD.

label: GI-TOC tables, SEDENA folio 330026424002125 (labs)
note: The same army register as folio 179, as published by GI-TOC from SEDENA folio 330026424002125: national counts identical to it in every year and drug from 1990 to 2022, and it runs to June 2024 (2024 is January to June). The main SEDENA line. Its map lacks 18 labs that its yearly table counts, so state figures add up to slightly less than the national line.

label: Quinto Elemento lab map (from SEDENA)
finest: One row per lab: municipality, exact day
note: Quinto Elemento Lab's map of army labs, January 2018 to December 2023, with the exact day; no drug produced. Identical to the register in 2018 to 2022 and to the yearly sheets in 2023.

label: SEDENA yearly results sheets (labs)
note: SEDENA's public yearly sheets, 2014 to September 2026 (2026 partial). Six to nine labs above the register in 2020 to 2022. A separate sheet for October 2024 to December 2025 reports 1,813 "labs and concentration areas", a wider count, not shown.

label: INEGI state police census (labs)
note: Labs seized by state police, 2024 and 2025 only. Most states report none (8 labs in 4 states in 2024; 21 in 5 states in 2025).

label: UNODC questionnaire, annex 9.1 (labs)
note: Mexico's answers to the UNODC questionnaire, 2020 to 2024, clandestine labs only. Equal to the FGR census in 2020 to 2022, so they look like the federal prosecutors' labs, not all agencies'.
